responsibility: Implements D’s C++ namespace declaration node. It inserts namespace members into a namespace-specific scope with default `extern(C++)` linkage, optionally keeps the namespace only for mangling without adding it as a visible symbol, imports the namespace scope into the enclosing scope for lookup, and forwards pointer/field-offset and member traversal queries through the namespace body.
same_name_distinction: This `.c` file implements namespace behavior; unlike `nspace.h`, which declares the `Nspace` AST/symbol class, it provides the scope insertion, implicit `extern(C++)` setup, search, member traversal, and field-offset/pointer propagation logic for namespace bodies.
